steps.code:

steps.title: open vlabench gripper · execute vlabench skill · vlabench scene
steps.code:
r_o = primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=8)
print('open', r_o.ok)
r_sk = primitives.call(name='execute_vlabench_skill', skill_name='grasp_entity',
                       target_name='salad_dressing', horizon=20)
print('skill', r_sk.ok)
so = r_sk.output if isinstance(r_sk.output, dict) else {}
print('stage_ok', so.get('stage_ok'), 'stepped', so.get('stepped'))
print([round(v,3) for v in (so.get('last_waypoint') or [])][:3])
r_obs = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene')
oge = r_obs.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
print('grasped', str(oge.get('grasped_obj_name'))[:120])

notes: noop_step calls the real upstream env.step(None) path for baseline validation
move_vlabench_ee_to requires an explicit visually derived target and uses robot.get_qpos_from_ee_pos plus env.step(action)
locate/inspect evidence handles carry same-observation entity-bound world targets for move/grasp/place
open_vlabench_gripper and close_vlabench_gripper write the gripper slots in the same control vector
lift_vlabench_ee uses SkillLib.lift and live env.step(action)
grasp_vlabench_entity and place_vlabench_entity_in call object-centric SkillLib controllers for agent-supplied targets
policy skill aliases rebind an agent-selected target to current native visual evidence before motion
settle_vlabench_scene advances the live simulator and returns observation evidence only
episode scoring remains outside the coding-agent primitive surface
